current_deterioration_gate.rule: 原评分卡：命中两项当前经营恶化触发，最终分最高49，且不得进入下一轮尽调。

material_blemishes: 2026-04-30 disclosed a major correction to 2025 Q1/H1/Q3 revenue-recognition accounting. It is incorporated in the audited FY2025 statements; it is a disclosure/earnings-quality penalty, not an automatic audit veto.

The 2026 H1 report says the former chairman 曾从钦 was removed after being investigated for suspected serious discipline/legal violations; as of the report, the company did not know the outcome. This remains a governance-risk monitor, not a finding against the company.
operating_deterioration_triggers: FY2025 attributable net profit was down 71.89% year on year on the audited, post-correction basis (trigger 1).

TTM operating cash flow was negative CNY3.584 billion: FY2025 CNY29.706bn minus restated 2025H1 CNY31.137bn plus 2026H1 negative CNY2.154bn. The disclosed collection-policy and bill-maturity explanation is not yet verified as a one-off, non-repeating working-capital movement (trigger 2).
